rules.title: Unbounded find
rules.description: find() over large collections without limit() or batch control in a script — memory and runtime blowup.

rules.title: $where with JavaScript
rules.description: $where executing server-side JavaScript — slow (no index use) and dangerous with interpolated input. Use native operators.

rules.title: Unanchored regex query
rules.description: $regex without ^ anchor on an indexed field — full collection scan.

rules.title: Full-document fetch
rules.description: Queries returning whole documents when a few fields are needed — network and memory waste in scripts.

rules.title: Query without a supporting index
rules.description: A new or changed query, sort or aggregation $match filters or sorts on fields that no existing index (visible in the repository's index definitions or scripts) supports, forcing a collection scan on a large collection. Name the fields and the missing or needed index. Do not record when the collection is clearly tiny or an index in the repository covers the access pattern.

rules.title: Expensive or unbounded $lookup
rules.description: $lookup without an indexed foreign field, placed before $match/$limit so it runs over the full input, or used in a hot path to join large collections. Recommend filtering first, indexing the foreign field, or denormalizing. Do not record joins over small reference collections.
